genZNote: Intrinsically resistant to most standard antibiotics before it even meets one — hospital microbiology treats it as a 'different rulebook' organism from the start.

habitat.naturalHabitat: Water, soil, plant surfaces, and moist hospital environments
habitat.hostAssociation: Environmental organism; opportunistic nosocomial pathogen, especially in immunocompromised or ventilated patients
habitat.environmentalOccurrence: Frequently isolated from hospital water systems, sinks, ventilator equipment, and indwelling devices
habitat.reservoir: Hospital water sources and contaminated medical equipment

culture.colonyMorphology: Smooth, lavender-green tinted colonies with an ammonia-like odor on some media
culture.pigmentation: Pale lavender-green tint on some media

biochemicalTests.result: Negative to weakly positive (variable, key distinguishing feature)

identificationClues: Oxidase-negative or only weakly positive, distinguishing it from most other non-fermenting Gram-negative rods like Pseudomonas
Intrinsically resistant to carbapenems and many other beta-lactams via a chromosomal metallo-beta-lactamase, making empiric therapy choices unusually narrow
Frequently recovered from respiratory secretions in ventilated or cystic fibrosis patients, though colonization vs. true infection can be hard to distinguish
Lavender-green tinted colonies with a distinctive ammonia-like smell on some media

clinicalImportance.transmission: Nosocomial — contaminated hospital water, equipment, and devices; not typically transmitted person-to-person
clinicalImportance.epidemiology: An increasingly recognized cause of healthcare-associated infection in critically ill and immunocompromised patients, notable for its unusual intrinsic resistance profile
clinicalImportance.labSignificance: Its oxidase-negative/weak result and intrinsic carbapenem resistance are key clues that separate it from Pseudomonas aeruginosa on an antibiogram

examFacts.importantTest: Oxidase test; antibiogram showing intrinsic carbapenem resistance
examFacts.distinguishingFeature: Intrinsically multidrug-resistant nonfermenter recovered from hospital water/equipment, distinct from Pseudomonas by its oxidase result
